generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: stem subterranean; leaves 3 to 10, 1.5 to 3 m long, with almost no petiole; leaflets 20 to 25 cm by 1 to 2 cm. Drawn as a trunk 0.12 m in radius, staying underground; fronds 2.2 m long, the petiole 0.03 of them, 48 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.1 of the frond; 2.5 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 10 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cones one to four on peduncles 7.5 to 13.8 cm; male cones one to four on peduncles 6 to 16 cm.

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: stem subterranean; leaves 3 to 10, 1.5 to 3 m long, with almost no petiole; leaflets 20 to 25 cm by 1 to 2 cm. The whole plant's height at 40 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 1.6 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them (the scientific name where no common name is in wide use), and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: female cones barrel-shaped, 40 to 50 cm long.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: female cone 16 to 20 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: the megasporophyll's face 4 to 6.3 cm high by 3.1 to 5.5 cm wide, its serrated lower edge overlapping the one below.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: female cones barrel-shaped.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: female cone bright yellow to apricot-yellow when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: male cones long conical, 50 to 60 cm long, with a strong odour.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: male cone 8 to 10 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: microsporophylls 3 to 3.5 cm long, the face 1 to 1.4 by 2.5 to 3.4 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: male cones long conical.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: male cone pale yellow to yellow-green; the colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: sclerotesta flattened, long ovoid, with 9 to 12 ridges, 2.8 to 3.1 cm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: sclerotesta 1.4 to 1.7 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: sarcotesta scarlet when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 240), Encephalartos villosus: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
